description.value: The Old Spaghetti Factory is a long-running Canadian Italian restaurant chain with a full sit-down location in Abbotsford, positioned beside the Coast Hotel just off Highway 1 on Sumas Way — a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley. The restaurant's signature 'all included' format bundles bread, soup or salad, dessert, and a hot drink with every entrée. Large-group inquiries are available for parties of seven or more, making it a practical option for group rides.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 32m; wall_loops (8 spaces) at 48m; rack (4 spaces) at 60m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the business is open at 2030 Sumas Way, Abbotsford with phone 604-854-1130, matching OSM tags. The menu explicitly labels vegetarian and gluten-free items, and the website navigation includes Pickup/Delivery links confirming takeout is available. No evidence for bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. The OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the address and website both confirm Abbotsford.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Chilliwack' but the business address and website both confirm the location is in Abbotsford — possible data entry error in the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible chain restaurant confirmed by a current and detailed location page on the brand website. Useful rest stop for touring cyclists on Highway 1 corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels individual items as 'vegetarian' (e.g., Garlic Cheese Toast, Parmesan Sweet Potato Fries) and 'gluten free' (e.g., Steamed Mussels). A dedicated Gluten Free menu tab is listed

price.label: Casual
price.signal: All-included meals at one low price; appetizers $9–14; casual chain
